reading.objective: Announce a small three-band night in a Leith venue and make it feel like a place and a mood, not a listing.
reading.audience: Local independent-music goers who read posters on walls and in shop windows.

concept.idea: The poster is a shoreline at low tide: dark water has withdrawn to a band at the top, leaving a wide flat of rippled sand where the name sits, so the title is literally what the page shows.
decisions: read first: the huge two-line 'Low / Tide' standing on the exposed sand
type: Fraunces at heavy weight for the soft, weathered title; Space Mono for the small details like a tide table
colour: salt-sand ground, deep marsh ink, one coral accent used only for the waterline and the call to action
composition: water band top, title left-aligned and large, a hard rule and a tide-table block of details below; sand ripples fill the space between
forms: one drawn shoreline path with an accent edge, and a faint ripple field in muted tan
